item_short_desc: Rothco's Adjustable Camo Fatigue Cap is designed for durability and comfort, making it the perfect choice for outdoor activities and rugged use. Crafted from a robust cotton and polyester blend, this baseball-styled cap combines the breathability of cotton with the strength of polyester for long-lasting wear. The tactical cap features an adjustable hook and loop closure, ensuring a secure and comfortable fit for all head sizes. Its camo pattern adds a unique touch while providing practical concealment in various environments.
